title: Place of business and posting of license.
bodyText: A licensed operator shall have and maintain a definite place of business in the State and shall display therein the operator's license.
bodyHtml: [§460J-11]  Place of business and posting of license.  A licensed operator shall have and maintain a definite place of business in the State and shall display therein the operator's license. [L 1972, c 134, pt of §1; gen ch 1993]
